title: Why Sitting Is Bad for You

cues.text: Right now, you're probably sitting down to watch this video
cues.en: Right now, you're probably sitting down to watch this video
cues.zh: 現在你大概正坐著要看這影片吧

cues.text: and staying seated for a few minutes to view it is probably okay.
cues.en: and staying seated for a few minutes to view it is probably okay.
cues.zh: 坐住幾分鐘來觀看它也許沒啥問題

cues.text: But the longer you stay put, the more agitated your body becomes.
cues.en: But the longer you stay put, the more agitated your body becomes.
cues.zh: 但是你一動也不動得越久 你的身體就會變得越焦慮

cues.text: It sits there counting down the moments until you stand up again
cues.en: It sits there counting down the moments until you stand up again
cues.zh: 它坐在那裡倒數著時間直到你再次起身

cues.text: and take it for a walk.
cues.en: and take it for a walk.
cues.zh: 帶著它去散個步

cues.text: That may sound ridiculous.
cues.en: That may sound ridiculous.
cues.zh: 這聽起來也許很荒謬

cues.text: Our bodies love to sit, right?
cues.en: Our bodies love to sit, right?
cues.zh: 我們的身體就喜歡坐著不是嗎？

cues.text: Not really.
cues.en: Not really.
cues.zh: 事實則不然

cues.text: Sure, sitting for brief periods can help us recover from stress
cues.en: Sure, sitting for brief periods can help us recover from stress
cues.zh: 坐一下子的確可以消除緊張

cues.text: or recuperate from exercise.
cues.en: or recuperate from exercise.
cues.zh: 或是運動後恢復體力

cues.text: But nowadays, our lifestyles make us sit much more than we move around,
cues.en: But nowadays, our lifestyles make us sit much more than we move around,
cues.zh: 只不過當今的生活型態使得我們 坐著的時候遠遠多過於在動的時候

cues.text: and our bodies simply aren't built for such a sedentary existence.
cues.en: and our bodies simply aren't built for such a sedentary existence.
cues.zh: 而我們的身體明明就不是 為瞭如此缺乏運動的生活而打造的

cues.text: In fact, just the opposite is true.
cues.en: In fact, just the opposite is true.
cues.zh: 事實上恰恰相反才對

cues.text: The human body is built to move,
cues.en: The human body is built to move,
cues.zh: 身體是為了移動而打造的

cues.text: and you can see evidence of that in the way it's structured.
cues.en: and you can see evidence of that in the way it's structured.
cues.zh: 我們可從其架構之方式找到證據

cues.text: Inside us are over 360 joints, and about 700 skeletal muscles
cues.en: Inside us are over 360 joints, and about 700 skeletal muscles
cues.zh: 我們體內有超過 360 個關節

cues.text: that enable easy, fluid motion.
cues.en: that enable easy, fluid motion.
cues.zh: 以及大約 700 條能讓輕鬆、 流利之動作體現的骨骼肌

cues.text: The body's unique physical structure gives us the ability to stand up straight
cues.en: The body's unique physical structure gives us the ability to stand up straight
cues.zh: 人體獨特的身體結構給了我們 抗拒重力的拉力而站直的能力

cues.text: against the pull of gravity.
cues.en: against the pull of gravity.
cues.zh: 血液有賴於我們四處動 才有辦法完善地迴圈

cues.text: Our blood depends on us moving around to be able to circulate properly.
cues.en: Our blood depends on us moving around to be able to circulate properly.
cues.zh: 血液有賴於我們四處動 才有辦法完善地迴圈

cues.text: Our nerve cells benefit from movement,
cues.en: Our nerve cells benefit from movement,
cues.zh: 我們的神經細胞能從運動中受益

cues.text: and our skin is elastic, meaning it molds to our motions.
cues.en: and our skin is elastic, meaning it molds to our motions.
cues.zh: 皮膚是有彈性的 代表它可以貼合我們的動作

cues.text: So if every inch of the body is ready and waiting for you to move,
cues.en: So if every inch of the body is ready and waiting for you to move,
cues.zh: 假若全身上下都準備好了 就等著你去動

cues.text: what happens when you just don't?
cues.en: what happens when you just don't?
cues.zh: 而你就是不動那會怎麼樣呢？

cues.text: Let's start with the backbone of the problem, literally.
cues.en: Let's start with the backbone of the problem, literally.
cues.zh: 讓我們從這問題的「中樞」開始來講：

cues.text: Your spine is a long structure
cues.en: Your spine is a long structure
cues.zh: 你的脊椎是由骨頭組成 而椎間盤坐落於其間的長條結構

cues.text: made of bones and the cartilage discs that sit between them.
cues.en: made of bones and the cartilage discs that sit between them.
cues.zh: 你的脊椎是由骨頭組成 而椎間盤坐落於其間的長條結構

cues.text: Joints, muscles and ligaments that are attached to the bones
cues.en: Joints, muscles and ligaments that are attached to the bones
cues.zh: 附著於脊椎骨的關節、肌肉和韌帶 把它包覆在一起的

cues.text: hold it all together.
cues.en: hold it all together.
cues.zh: 一般的坐法帶著微曲的背部、下放的雙肩

cues.text: A common way of sitting is with a curved back and slumped shoulders,
cues.en: A common way of sitting is with a curved back and slumped shoulders,
cues.zh: 一般的坐法帶著微曲的背部、下放的雙肩

cues.text: a position that puts uneven pressure on your spine.
cues.en: a position that puts uneven pressure on your spine.
cues.zh: 是一種讓脊椎受力不均的姿勢

cues.text: Over time, this causes wear and tear in your spinal discs,
cues.en: Over time, this causes wear and tear in your spinal discs,
cues.zh: 長時間下來會造成椎間盤磨損、 過度操用部分韌帶與關節

cues.text: overworks certain ligaments and joints,
cues.en: overworks certain ligaments and joints,
cues.zh: 以及對延展以配合你微曲 背姿的肌肉造成壓迫

cues.text: and puts strain on muscles that stretch
cues.en: and puts strain on muscles that stretch
cues.zh: 以及對延展以配合你微曲 背姿的肌肉造成壓迫

cues.text: to accommodate your back's curved position.
cues.en: to accommodate your back's curved position.
cues.zh: 以及對延展以配合你微曲 背姿的肌肉造成壓迫

cues.text: This hunched shape also shrinks your chest cavity while you sit,
cues.en: This hunched shape also shrinks your chest cavity while you sit,
cues.zh: 當你彎腰坐著還會限縮到你的胸腔

cues.text: meaning your lungs have less space to expand into when you breath.
cues.en: meaning your lungs have less space to expand into when you breath.
cues.zh: 表示當你呼吸時肺部只有 較小的空間能吸進擴張

cues.text: That's a problem because it temporarily limits the amount of oxygen
cues.en: That's a problem because it temporarily limits the amount of oxygen
cues.zh: 這就是個問題了

cues.text: that fills your lungs and filters into your blood.
cues.en: that fills your lungs and filters into your blood.
cues.zh: 因為它會暫時地限制住充填你的肺部 和濾進血液裡的氧氣量

cues.text: Around the skeleton are the muscles, nerves, arteries and veins
cues.en: Around the skeleton are the muscles, nerves, arteries and veins
cues.zh: 骨骼週圍是組成人體軟組織層的 肌肉、神經與血管

cues.text: that form the body's soft tissue layers.
cues.en: that form the body's soft tissue layers.
cues.zh: 「坐下」這動作就是在壓平、壓迫、擠壓

cues.text: The very act of sitting squashes, pressurizes and compresses,
cues.en: The very act of sitting squashes, pressurizes and compresses,
cues.zh: 「坐下」這動作就是在壓平、壓迫、擠壓

cues.text: and these more delicate tissues really feel the brunt.
cues.en: and these more delicate tissues really feel the brunt.
cues.zh: 而且這些較為嬌嫩的細胞 確實感受得到壓力

cues.text: Have you ever experienced numbness and swelling in your limbs when you sit?
cues.en: Have you ever experienced numbness and swelling in your limbs when you sit?
cues.zh: 你是否有過坐著時下肢麻木、腫脹?

cues.text: In areas that are the most compressed,
cues.en: In areas that are the most compressed,
cues.zh: 承受最大壓力的部位中

cues.text: your nerves, arteries and veins can become blocked,
cues.en: your nerves, arteries and veins can become blocked,
cues.zh: 神經、血管會被阻斷

cues.text: which limits nerve signaling, causing the numbness,
cues.en: which limits nerve signaling, causing the numbness,
cues.zh: 阻礙神經訊號會導致下肢麻木

cues.text: and reduces blood flow in your limbs, causing them to swell.
cues.en: and reduces blood flow in your limbs, causing them to swell.
cues.zh: 還有使流進下肢的血液變少 造成下肢水腫

cues.text: Sitting for long periods also temporarily deactivates lipoprotein lipase,
cues.en: Sitting for long periods also temporarily deactivates lipoprotein lipase,
cues.zh: 長時間坐著還會暫時地讓 「脂蛋白脂肪酶」失去功用

cues.text: a special enzyme in the walls of blood capillaries
cues.en: a special enzyme in the walls of blood capillaries
cues.zh: 那是一種特殊酶素 在血管壁裡摧毀血液當中的脂肪

cues.text: that breaks down fats in the blood,
cues.en: that breaks down fats in the blood,
cues.zh: 所以在坐著時燃燒脂肪很難做到 接近與你在動的時候一樣好

cues.text: so when you sit, you're not burning fat nearly as well as when you move around.
cues.en: so when you sit, you're not burning fat nearly as well as when you move around.
cues.zh: 所以在坐著時燃燒脂肪很難做到 接近與你在動的時候一樣好

cues.text: What effect does all of this stasis have on the brain?
cues.en: What effect does all of this stasis have on the brain?
cues.zh: 到底這種靜滯對大腦有什麼影響呢？

cues.text: Most of the time, you probably sit down to use your brain,
cues.en: Most of the time, you probably sit down to use your brain,
cues.zh: 絕大多數時間你大概是坐著動腦

cues.text: but ironically, lengthy periods of sitting actually run counter to this goal.
cues.en: but ironically, lengthy periods of sitting actually run counter to this goal.
cues.zh: 不過諷刺的是久坐 事實上與這個目標背道而馳

cues.text: Being stationary reduces blood flow
cues.en: Being stationary reduces blood flow
cues.zh: 在靜止不動之下會讓血液流量 以及經肺部進入血液的氧含量變少

cues.text: and the amount of oxygen entering your blood stream through your lungs.
cues.en: and the amount of oxygen entering your blood stream through your lungs.
cues.zh: 在靜止不動之下會讓血液流量 以及經肺部進入血液的氧含量變少

cues.text: Your brain requires both of those things to remain alert,
cues.en: Your brain requires both of those things to remain alert,
cues.zh: 你的大腦要保持清醒兩者都需要

cues.text: so your concentration levels will most likely dip
cues.en: so your concentration levels will most likely dip
cues.zh: 因此當你的大腦運作慢下來了

cues.text: as your brain activity slows.
cues.en: as your brain activity slows.
cues.zh: 你的專注程度極可能下滑

cues.text: Unfortunately, the ill effects of being seated don't only exist in the short term.
cues.en: Unfortunately, the ill effects of being seated don't only exist in the short term.
cues.zh: 很不幸地一直坐著的負面影響 不是隻限於短期而已

cues.text: Recent studies have found that sitting for long periods
cues.en: Recent studies have found that sitting for long periods
cues.zh: 最近研究發現久坐與某些型別的 癌症、心臟疾病有關

cues.text: is linked with some types of cancers and heart disease
cues.en: is linked with some types of cancers and heart disease
cues.zh: 最近研究發現久坐與某些型別的 癌症、心臟疾病有關

cues.text: and can contribute to diabetes, kidney and liver problems.
cues.en: and can contribute to diabetes, kidney and liver problems.
cues.zh: 還會導致糖尿病與肝、腎之毛病

cues.text: In fact, researchers have worked out that, worldwide,
cues.en: In fact, researchers have worked out that, worldwide,
cues.zh: 事實上研究人員們已經計算出在全世界

cues.text: inactivity causes about 9% of premature deaths a year.
cues.en: inactivity causes about 9% of premature deaths a year.
cues.zh: 欠缺運動造成一年大約 9 ％ 的早逝率

cues.text: That's over 5 million people.
cues.en: That's over 5 million people.
cues.zh: 那可是5百多萬人呀

cues.text: So what seems like such a harmless habit
cues.en: So what seems like such a harmless habit
cues.zh: 所以這種看似無害之習慣者

cues.text: actually has the power to change our health.
cues.en: actually has the power to change our health.
cues.zh: 其實對健康影響深遠

cues.text: But luckily, the solutions to this mounting threat are simple and intuitive.
cues.en: But luckily, the solutions to this mounting threat are simple and intuitive.
cues.zh: 不過幸好對這種積累性危害的 解決之道既簡單又不需動腦

cues.text: When you have no choice but to sit,
cues.en: When you have no choice but to sit,
cues.zh: 當你非坐不可時

cues.text: try switching the slouch for a straighter spine,
cues.en: try switching the slouch for a straighter spine,
cues.zh: 試著把無精打採的彎著腰 轉換成挺直的胸膛

cues.text: and when you don't have to be bound to your seat,
cues.en: and when you don't have to be bound to your seat,
cues.zh: 而當你不必黏在位置上時

cues.text: aim to move around much more,
cues.en: aim to move around much more,
cues.zh: 訂下運動更多的目標吧

cues.text: perhaps by setting a reminder to yourself to get up every half hour.
cues.en: perhaps by setting a reminder to yourself to get up every half hour.
cues.zh: 也許利用設定每半小時 站起來一次的提醒給自己

cues.text: But mostly, just appreciate that bodies are built for motion, not for stillness.
cues.en: But mostly, just appreciate that bodies are built for motion, not for stillness.
cues.zh: 最主要的是要理解你的身體 是為了動作而非呆滯而生

cues.text: In fact, since the video's almost over, why not stand up and stretch right now?
cues.en: In fact, since the video's almost over, why not stand up and stretch right now?
cues.zh: 這影片即將結束 何不站起來伸展一下呢

cues.text: Treat your body to a walk.
cues.en: Treat your body to a walk.
cues.zh: 犒賞身體去散個步

cues.text: It'll thank you later.
cues.en: It'll thank you later.
cues.zh: 稍後它將會感謝你的！
